layout.scene: A meeting room with a rectangular conference table between a presentation screen and a glass door. Windows line one side and a clear walkway runs along the opposite side. No other people are present.
layout.public_intro: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side.

establish.public_view: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats in frame.

partial_pair.public_view: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

partial_first.public_view: Close-up from the walkway side, centered on the person in the screen-side window seat.

partial_second.public_view: Close-up from the walkway side, centered on the person in the door-side window seat.

probe_reverse.public_view: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats in frame.

probe_overhead.public_view: Top-down wide shot from directly above the conference table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats in frame.
